findings.text: `unsetopt local_options nomatch` turns off `local_options` itself instead of enabling it, and also turns off `nomatch`. The function's option changes are therefore not restored on return, so after `nvm_list_aliases` runs in zsh (e.g. `nvm alias`/`nvm ls`) the user's shell keeps `nomatch` disabled. Afterwards `ls *.nomatch` in the interactive shell passes the literal pattern instead of erroring. The intended line is `setopt local_options nonomatch`.
